full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J: This petition for leave to appeal by the plaintiff-petitioners is for the judgment and order dated 26-5-92 passed by a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1334 of 1989 making the Rule absolute and setting aside the judgment and decree of the lower appellate Court, Subordinate Judge, Natore, in Title Appeal No. 30 of 1988 dated 30-8-89 affirming those of the trial court, learned Assistant Judge, Lalpur Upazila, Natore in Title Suit No. 220 of 1984, decreeing the suit. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the suit and the lower appellate Court, as already noticed, affirmed the same.
